description: Knowledge-update and staleness recall fixtures for engram.recall.evals. Each fixture seeds its own store and checks which facts recall delivers, which it must not, the top card, and warning codes. Deterministic: no LLM calls.

fixtures.name: superseded_fact_replaced_by_newer
fixtures.description: An old fact superseded by a newer one on the same memory_key: only the new one is delivered.

facts.content: Engramx stores memory facts in a SQLite database backend.
Engramx stores memory facts in an append-only JSONL event log backend.

fixtures.name: correction_supersedes_reworded_fact
fixtures.description: A correction that rewords the old fact still hides the superseded one.

facts.content: Production deploys go to Heroku through the release pipeline.
Production deploys now happen on Fly.io; Heroku is no longer used.

fixtures.name: stale_fact_excluded
fixtures.description: A fact marked stale never reaches recall; its live replacement does.

facts.content: The staging database runs Postgres version 13.
The staging database runs Postgres version 16.

fixtures.name: old_ephemeral_event_ranks_below_durable
fixtures.description: A 120-day-old ephemeral event with the same wording as a durable fact must not outrank it.
